headword: {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: A work of fiction that is shorter than a novel, typically focusing on a single plot or theme. Generally under about 100 pages.

examples.japanese: {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}を{書|か}く。
この{作家|さっか}は{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}が{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: This author excels at short stories.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}{集|しゅう}が{文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
examples.english: Her collection of short stories won a literary prize.

notes:
Composed of {短編|たんぺん} (short piece) + {小説|しょうせつ} (novel, fiction). Refers to fictional prose that is significantly shorter than a novel, usually focused on a single episode or theme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}{集|しゅう}: short story collection
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}を{書|か}く: to write a short story
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}を{読|よ}む: to read a short story

RELATED WORDS:
- {長編小説|ちょうへんしょうせつ}: full-length novel
- {中編小説|ちゅうへんしょうせつ}: novella, medium-length fiction
- {掌編小説|しょうへんしょうせつ}: flash fiction, very short story
- {短編|たんぺん}: short piece (can refer to short stories, films, etc.)

USAGE:
Often abbreviated to just {短編|たんぺん} in conversation when the context makes it clear that fiction is being discussed.
